description: Header file defining functions and structures related to the health monitoring of a filesystem monitor daemon. It declares initialization, cleanup, event loop, and shutdown functions for the health thread, conditioned on the presence of a backend implementation.

methods.name: fsm_health__ctor
methods.description: Initializes platform-specific data for the fsmonitor health thread, called before starting the thread.

methods.name: fsm_health__dtor
methods.description: Cleans up platform-specific data for the health thread, called after the thread has been joined.

methods.name: fsm_health__loop
methods.description: Main function of the platform-specific event loop that monitors the health of the daemon process, running in the health thread.

methods.name: fsm_health__stop_async
methods.description: Requests the health thread to shut down asynchronously, without waiting for it to complete.
